title: 先端材料
subtitle: Advanced Materials
keywords: Phase transformation 2.Microstructure control 3.Thermo-mechanical treatment 4.Ultra steels 5.Mechanisms of strengthening
educationalGoal: It can be easily predicted that advanced functional materials will greatly contribute to the development of science and technology in the future. In this lecture, students will learn the basics of crystal structure, lattice defects, phase transformation and structure modification that affect the functionality of these advanced materials. In addition, students will list some specific advanced materials and learn their characteristics.
advice: 1: Basics of crystallography and mechanics of deformation 2: Characteristics of lattice defects 3: Basics of phase transformation 4: Modify and control of microstructures based on equilibrium phase diagram 5: Relation between functions of materials and microstructures 6: Relation between strengthening of materials and lattice defects, especially dislocation
books: Reference material: material strength and fracture mechanics and physics of metallic materials. No specific recommendations.
requiredKnowledge: Review basics of crystallography, mechanisms of slip deformation, lattice defects, microstructure control, and so on which were learned in Materials Science I&II.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain relationship between microstructures and mechanical properties.
Be able to explain phase stability and phase transformation by using phase diagram.
Be able to explain relationship between microstructures and functional properties.
Be able to explain characteristics of typical advanced materials.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Explain and classify functional advanced materials around us. 2. Explain the functions and characteristics of advanced materials by using technical terms. 3. Explain the relationship among microstructures, physical and chemical properties and functionality of advanced materials by using technical terms. 4. Explain the function expression mechanism of advanced materials by using technical terms.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Explain and classify materials around us. 2. Explain the functions and characteristics of advanced materials by using simple terms. 3. Explain the functions, characteristics, and practical examples of advanced materials. 4. Explain the function expression mechanism of advanced materials by using simple terms.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Course introduction [Self-check] Review imperfect knowledge in Materials Science I & II. Develop future learning plans.
[Lecture] Learn microstructures and characteristics of materials.
lessons.assignments: Preview crystal structures, physical and chemical properties (melting point, elastic constant, density, and so on) of pure materials (Au, Cu, Fe, Mg, Si and so on).

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn crystal structures of pure materials. Learn the basics of crystallography, especially crystal systems, space lattice, unit cell, Bravais lattices, Miller index.
lessons.assignments: Before the class, review Bravais lattices and Miller index studied on Materials Science I.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn lattice defects, strengthening and the function expression mechanism of materials.
lessons.assignments: Before the class, review lattice defects, especially dislocations.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn relation between lattice defects and strengthening of materials.
lessons.assignments: Before the class, review the strengthening of materials studied on Materials Science II.

lessons.content: [Quiz 1] Check the level of understanding the lectures from the 1st to the 5th classes. [Lecture] Learn equilibrium phase diagram based on thermodynamics. Learn phase transformations that occur in a thermodynamically non-equilibrium state.
lessons.assignments: Review the 1st to the 5th classes for the preparation of quiz 1. Before the class, review the technical terms; solid solution, precipitation, crystallization, eutectoid reaction, eutectic reaction and so on, which are studied on Materials Science I & II.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] Return quiz 1 and give the answer. Present exercises related to quiz 1.
lessons.assignments: Before the class, review the 1st to the 5th classes for the preparation of Q&A session.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn microstructures affected by phase transformation and cooling speed.
[Lecture] Learn basics of thermomechanical treatment and application of microstructures control.
[Lecture] Learn relationship between ultra steels and microstructures.

[Quiz 2] Check the level of understanding the lectures from the 7th to the 10th classes. [Integrated learning] Learn the function expression mechanism of advanced materials and applications. Learn relationship between crystal texture and mechanical properties.
lessons.assignments: Review the 7th to the 10th classes for the preparation of quiz 2. Review the lecture.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] Return quiz 2 and give the answer Present exercises related to quiz 2.
lessons.assignments: Before the class, review the 7th to the 10th classes for the preparation of Q&A session.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn characteristics of engineering ceramics and sintered alloys.
[Integrated learning] Summarized the all classes. [Exam] Evaluate the degree of the achievement for the all lectures.
lessons.assignments: Review the all classes by using your note, distributed materials, text book, and so on.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] Return Exam and present the answer. In order to be solving the questions, fixing the knowledge and so on, review the past lectures. [Self-check] Self -check of the quiz and exam. Consider the future learning-plan.
lessons.operation: Return the exam. Give an answer of the exam and explain it. Comment on the received report.
